We took our puppy here when he was 4 months old to have a doctor, but after several times he was not examined properly, not even once, saying that he is healthy, what do I want? Now for 50,000 HUF, they pulled out his 2 milk teeth under anesthesia in 10 minutes, the assistant snatched him out of my hand, saying that we should go far enough, then the door opened and I saw that he was tied up with a leash at the foot of the table. I asked him several times to see what the problem was, because his mouth has been very smelly for 3-4 weeks, he swallows his saliva strangely, I was told that it was because of the teething, bloody teeth have this smell. I couldn't accept this somehow and how good it is that I took him somewhere else, because it turned out in a moment that he had tonsillitis, which a blood test immediately showed after the examination, a bacterial infection that had been going on for 3 weeks. He could have had a bigger problem, he is now receiving antibiotics and it is interesting that 2 days later, his breath didn't smell anymore. The assistant filled out the pet passport all over again, who told me in an arrogant tone that a miniature poodle is the same as a toy poodle, doesn't it matter what it says there? The vaccination book says miniature, the pet passport says toy poodle. She then rewrote all this with a typo for 25,000 HUF. The doctor is nice, there's no problem with that, but we don't go to the doctor because of the kindness, we have an appointment which is good but we are left out after about 5 minutes which is a pretty bad feeling, especially at these prices. It was a disappointment!
